description.value: The 101 Brewhouse + Distillery has been the community gathering spot in Upper Gibsons since 2017, brewing award-winning craft beers — including a 2022 BC Beer Awards first-place lager — and distilling small-batch gin and vodka made from BC-grown ingredients. The kitchen turns out a broad menu of locally-inspired dishes alongside the taps, and the venue runs a steady calendar of live music, trivia nights, and themed events. For a touring cyclist arriving on the Sunshine Coast, it offers a full sit-down meal with vegetarian and gluten-free options plus online ordering for takeaway.

address.value: 1009 Gibsons Way, Gibsons, British Columbia, V0N 1V8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: address, phone, and name all match exactly. Takeout is confirmed by the front-page title 'Takeaway food' and a prominent 'Order Online' feature. The food menu explicitly marks GF items and a vegetarian gyoza option, and the site states 'our menu covers most dietary requirements.' No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Bike parking not mentioned on website or in OSM tags — follow-up visit or inquiry recommended to confirm whether a rack exists before publishing the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established craft brewery and full-service restaurant in central Gibsons; a natural stop for touring cyclists arriving on the Sunshine Coast with food, takeout, and dietary options confirmed.
enrichment_extras.notes: Postal code V0N 1V8 appears on the website contact page but was absent from the OSM address field; included in the address above.
